'''Jaden Korr's lightsaber''' was a weapon constructed by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]].

==History==
[[File:Taspir.png|thumb|200px|Taspir III, where Korr's ultimate test took place.]]

===Construction===
{{Quote|Jaden, you handled yourself exceptionally well on Vjun. To confront three Dark Jedi and defeat them took both bravery and skill. For your efforts, I feel that you are ready to join our ranks as a Jedi Knight.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to Jaden|audio=JadenKnighting.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />}}
After losing his [[Jaden Korr's first lightsaber|first lightsaber]] during his [[Mission to Vjun (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|mission on Vjun]], Jaden built a new green-bladed lightsaber and became even stronger within [[The Force/Legends|The Force]]. He continued to work at [[Mission to Chandrila|thwarting]] the cult's operations on [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], [[Mission to Taanab|Taanab]], and other planets. When Luke Skywalker discovered the cult's intentions, Korr was recalled to the Academy to serve as part of a Jedi strike team that would stop [[Disciples of Ragnos|the Cult of Ragnos]] from attempting to restore [[Marka Ragnos]] to life. However, [[Kyle Katarn]] pulled Korr aside and informed him that he had received a message from Penin, who had repented of his actions and wished to rejoin the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. Katarn and Korr detoured to [[Taspir III]] to [[Mission to Taspir III|rescue]] Rosh from the cult.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

Korr finally reached Penin, but at the sight of him seemingly unharmed, his anger rose, believing that his former friend - who was always trying to beat Jaden - had lured him into a trap. [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], who stood on a balcony above them and watched, thought Jaden's feelings could drive him to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], and tried to amplify his rage to gain a new ally which would have meant certain death for the redeemed Rosh. Rosh became afraid of Jaden's growing anger, but admitted to him that that he had fallen due to his fear. He also reminded Jaden that anger was also a path to the dark side. This, along with the help of Katarn's [[Telepathy/Legends|mental warnings]], allowed Korr to let go of his anger, realizing he had let it control him, and did not attack Rosh. At this point, Alora attacked, [[Cho mok/Legends|slicing off]] Penin's left arm, but Korr was able to defeat her in a hard-fought battle. When Kyle caught up with his students, he commended Jaden for not giving into the dark side, but Jaden gave the credit to Rosh for having reminded him.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

[[File:Alora_Jaden_Rosh.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Alora tries to corrupt Jaden by his struggle with the dark side.]]
Leaving Rosh in the care of Kyle, Jaden flew to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] world of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], where he joined up with the Jedi strike force to stop the cult once and for all. He reached [[Tomb of Marka Ragnos|Ragnos's Tomb]] and [[Battle of Korriban (Disciples of Ragnos crisis)|confronted]] Tavion before she could resurrect [[Marka Ragnos]]. Tavion fought with fury and hatred, using the [[Scepter of Ragnos]] to boost her advantage. However Jaden's skill outmatched and defeated her, but Tavion refused to surrender. She managed to somewhat resurrect the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]], but he came out only as a [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]], who possessed her. After a duel with the possessed Tavion, Jaden destroyed the scepter and Ragnos left Tavion's body. Her body could not withstand the corruption and died shortly thereafter. Jaden left the tomb and sealed it. He joined Luke and Kyle on the steps of the mausoleum. There they proclaimed him to be a true Jedi Knight.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy" />

===Continued service===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Korr was on a mission when his homeworld of [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Coruscant]] fell to the [[Yuuzhan Vong|extragalctic invaders]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. He later learned that his uncle [[Orn]] had been killed in the battle.<ref name="Riptide" />

Following the Yuuzhan Vong War, Korr assisted [[Jan Ors]] in her hunt to locate his former master, Kyle Katarn, who had vanished while searching for missing Jedi [[Daye Azur-Jamin]]. They spent every spare moment searching for any clues indicating where Kyle could have been. He later found and freed him from Daye Azur-Jamin who had become a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="dfs">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>

Korr was stationed at the [[New Jedi Temple]] as of [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]]. He assisted Jedi Master [[Kyp Durron]], [[Valin Horn]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Toval Seyah]], and several other Jedi on a [[Battle of Centerpoint Station (Second Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to destroy [[Centerpoint Station]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="fury">''[[Legacy of the Force: Fury]]''</ref> During the mission, Korr and his team encountered stiff resistance from the Confederation and Corellian sympathizers. After a short battle, the soldiers and several members of the station's crew retreated into a cargo hold, blocking off the Jedi's way. Left without the time to force them out or negotiate a surrender, Jaden opened the hold to space, killing the soldiers and engineers alike. He would later reflect on this decision with doubt and remorse, despite having followed the orders of a fellow Jedi.<ref name="CC" />

===Quest for certainty===
{{Quote|There be dragons&hellip;|Jaden Korr on his doubts in himself, the Jedi and the Force|<ref name="CC" />}}
Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Jaden had insulated himself from his friends and fellow Jedi, living in a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] apartment outside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], when he received a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] from the Force. In the vision, Jaden found himself on the surface of a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] surrounded by the voices of dead Jedi and Sith calling his name. One of the voices, belonging to [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], told him to travel to the Black Hole on Fhost. The vision ended with a explosion in the sky that rained down dark side energy, leaving Jaden sickened and someone calling for help. Hoping to find answers that would bring him peace of mind, Jaden left for [[Fhost]] without informing the Jedi Order. Upon his arrival, Jaden learned that the crew of the salvage vessel [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']] had stumbled on a automated distress beacon in the Unknown Regions; convinced that it would lead him to his quest, Jaden approached the ''Junker''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Khedryn Faal]], in the [[Black Hole (Fhost)|Black Hole]] cantina on Fhost.<ref name="CC" />

Obsessed with finding an answer to his moral confusion, he even used a [[Mind trick/Legends|Jedi mind trick]] on Faal, but was interrupted by Farr's first mate, [[Marr Idi-Shael]], who urged Faal to partake in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game, during which they lost the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] coordinates to a local criminal named [[Earsh]]. Sensing that the game was rigged, Jaden used the Force to help Faal win it back during a double-or-nothing round, and then helped ''Junker's'' crew to escape the following [[Brawl in the Black Hole|firefight]]. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] then agreed to [[Mission to the frozen moon|bring him]] to the frozen [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of his vision, but just after arriving in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], they witnessed the arrival of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Harbinger (Sith dreadnaught)|''Harbinger'']] that had [[Time travel/Legends|misjumped]] five thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] through [[Time/Legends|time]]. Rescuing Jedi Master [[Relin Druur]], who had caused the misjump five thousand years ago, Jaden learned that the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side energy]] he felt in his vision and from ''Harbinger'' was caused by the cargo of [[Lignan crystal]]s. Even though Jaden felt Relin falling to his anger over the death of his Padawan, [[Saes Rrogon]], who had now become a Sith, and Relin in turn felt Jaden lost in doubt, both agreed that they had to go their own way.<ref name="CC" />

After convincing the crew of the ''Junker'' that the Force had brought them to the moon, they decided that Marr would fly Relin in ''Harbinger''{{'s}} landing bay to destroy the ship while Faal would land Jaden on the moon. There, they discovered a secret [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] research station where a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] had combined Jedi and Sith [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] to create [[Cloning/Legends|clones]]. Later, the clones had killed all the scientists and [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Faal voted for leaving the moon at once, but Jaden was too obsessed to turn around now and continued alone to the lower levels. Hoping that clones who could use dark and light side like himself would provide him with answers to his dilemma, Jaden advanced through the carnage till he reached the [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]] "Mother", which the clones had filled with the remains of the scientists and stormtroopers. There, he encountered [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], a clone of [[Kam Solusar]] who informed him that he and his [[Community|fellow clones]] would use Jaden's ship to leave the moon. They fought until Alpha took three fingers off Jaden's right hand with his lightsaber and tried to drown him in the cloning cylinder. Faced with his fear of death, Jaden briefly unleashed [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], but realized just in time that he had let the dark side swell in him. Right when Alpha was about to deliver the killing blow, Jaden pulled out his [[Color/Legends|purple]]-bladed lightsaber and killed the clone by [[Shiak|stabbing]] him in the chest.<ref name="CC" />
